Name: Haley Ice Cream Customized
Author: MSGASMDC
Description:
This is a personally customised version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/754/]Haley Ice Cream[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/39477655]espectOracle89[/url]. I originally made it because I disliked the inconsistent sprites, with the ice cream jumping all over Haley's face throughout conversations. I'm not as good a pixel artist as [b]espectOracle[/b], so Haley's mostly storing ice cream in her mouth, because it was simple to copy between facial expressions.

Included is a custom sprite sheet for her world sprites, adding a few small edits to show her ice cream outside of dialogue too, in select situations.

Also included are my own modifications to the weapon sprites and descriptions, changing the (unobtainable) weapon [b]Haley's Iron[/b] into [b]Haley's Used 'Toy'[/b], complete with a fitting new description and look.



[size=3][b][size=4]Installation:[/size]
[/b][size=2]
[/size][/size]Unpack the file, then navigate to your game directory, usually located at  [b]C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley[/b]

The file contains folders with the same names as folders inside your Stardew Valley directory. Copy the .xnb files from each folder in the mod to their corresponding folder in the directory. Voilà!
[b]
[u]MAKE SURE TO BACK UP THE ORIGINAL FILES BEFORE OVERWRITING THEM[/u]
[/b][i]I've even included blank folders to make that easy![/i]



[b][size=3][size=4]Compatability:[/size]

[/size][/b]Because these are .xnb files and not Content Patcher integrated (because this is literally my first mod and I don't know how to do that shit), [i][b]this mod will completely overwrite any custom sprites you may have for Haley's portrait or character sprites, or any custom weapons you may have, both sprites and descriptions.[/b][/i]

That said, if you wanna just use these little edits in your own mod, or simply just integrate them into your already modified game, be my guest! If you're not sure how to do that, the first thing you'll need is [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/modding-guides-and-general-modding-discussion-redux.109131/page-6#post-2837587]Drogeon's Easy XNB Pack/UnPack Toolkit[/url]﻿. Once you've used that, it's as easy as a Copy/Paste in your image editor of choice! That's literally how I made this mod!

Downloads.Description: Contains portrait sprite, character sprite, weapon sprite and weapon description files, as well as preview images, and some blank folders to easily store backups
